# Explicitly deny unsupported WebRTC requests so the offer promise rejects

BrowserProcessChild observes PeerConnection:request and sends PeerConnection:response:deny with subject.callID. MailGlue registers it as a per-process child observer; the extension test creates a data channel and asserts createOffer rejection before notifying completion. Keep an explicit denial response rather than only logging an unsupported feature. This source contract does not claim WebRTC is enabled or that the paired platform implementation was run. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.

Scope: mail/actors/BrowserProcessChild.sys.mjs.
